need: Hazard: the multibyte arithmetic of the cap. The 2005 environment law extracts to 152 785 characters, and the index cap is counted in characters, not bytes: Điều 135 sits at character 147 001, so a reader asking when the law took effect gets nothing, while the same question against the shorter 2010 law misses by only 1 951 characters. Vietnamese carries two or three UTF-8 bytes per accented letter, so a byte-counted cap of the same nominal size would truncate this page around character 34 000 instead of 40 000 — a different, and wrong, answer set.
query: Luật Bảo vệ môi trường 2005 có hiệu lực thi hành từ ngày nào và thay thế luật nào

expected_miss_mechanism: index_fulltext_max_chars: Điều 135 lies at character 147 001 of the 152 785-character extraction, far past the 40 000-character cap; the cap is counted in characters, so the indexed prefix of this diacritic-heavy Vietnamese page is 40 000 characters and roughly 47 000 UTF-8 bytes, and neither reaches the commencement article
